positive_terms: Disclosure of whether and how policy adresses commitment to reduce material water consumption in areas at water risk
水风险地区耗水减量承诺
Disclosure of whether and how policy adresses commitment to reduce material water consumption in areas at water risk。水风险地区耗水减量承诺。水管理、取用采购、水处理、污染预防、风险区减量及海洋保护分开。高水压力区域未采纳政策的说明不能当作集团全部无政策。
